summary: Observation fire tower near Catfish Lake, Ontario, mapped in OpenStreetMap as an abandoned building; no build, staffing or fate history found.

evidence.supports: Named as a fire tower in OpenStreetMap
Entry carries the abandoned:building tag; the only condition-related content in the entry
Visibility from ON-17 west of Catfish Lake and from Steephill Dam Road
evidence.quote: Can be seen from ON-17 while driving west of Catfish Lake, and from Steephill Dam Road at the dam and directly south of the tower.

notes_for_editor: Only one readable source: the OpenStreetMap node, whose tags are fire_lookout, tower:type observation and abandoned:building, plus a visibility note. The brief's firelookout.ca slug for this tower was not found (404 on a guessed slug; the brief gave no firelookout URL), and the Facebook group and Canadian lookout index did not list it. The Ontario GeoHub tower dataset was not readable. Nothing read gives a build year, staffing, a fire, or what the site is today. The record's status 'ruins' is not stated by any source; the OSM tag says abandoned building. The OSM page gives its last edit only as 'about 4 years ago'. Recommend a register or ministry history check before this story is treated as more than a stub. No photos found.
